definitions.rationale: This unguarded equation expands the total named proof term circularShiftClosure into the exact closureVal constructor tree for the translated function body. It defines a syntax summary and does not add or replace an execution step.
definitions.text:
rule circularShiftClosure
    => closureVal(
         ("x", "shift", .ParamNames),
         Assign(Name("s"), Call(Name("str"), (Name("x"), .Exprs)))
         Return(
           IfExp(
             Compare(
               Name("shift"),
               CmpOp(">", Call(Name("len"), (Name("s"), .Exprs)))),
             Subscript(
               Name("s"),
               Slice(NoBound, NoBound, UnaryOp("-", Int(1)))),
             IfExp(
               Compare(Name("shift"), CmpOp("<", Int(0))),
               Name("s"),
               Subscript(
                 BinOp("+", Name("s"), Name("s")),
                 Slice(
                   BinOp(
                     "-",
                     Call(Name("len"), (Name("s"), .Exprs)),
                     Name("shift")),
                   BinOp(
                     "-",
                     BinOp(
                       "*",
                       Int(2),
                       Call(Name("len"), (Name("s"), .Exprs))),
                     Name("shift")),
                   NoBound)))))
         .Stmts,
         0)

definitions.rationale: This guarded equation defines the oversized-shift case of the total circularShiftResult summary using the existing decimal-code and slicing helpers. It is one case of the result function's defining equations.
definitions.text:
rule circularShiftResult(X:Int, SHIFT:Int)
    => str(buildIS(
         strToCodes(Int2String(X)),
         isLen(strToCodes(Int2String(X))) -Int 1,
         -1,
         -1))
    requires SHIFT >Int isLen(strToCodes(Int2String(X)))

definitions.rationale: This guarded equation defines the negative-shift case of the total circularShiftResult summary as the original decimal string. It is one case of the result function's defining equations.
definitions.text:
rule circularShiftResult(X:Int, SHIFT:Int)
    => str(strToCodes(Int2String(X)))
    requires notBool (
               SHIFT >Int isLen(strToCodes(Int2String(X))))
      andBool SHIFT <Int 0

definitions.rationale: This guarded equation defines the ordinary rotation case of the total circularShiftResult summary as a normalized slice of the doubled decimal-code sequence. It is one case of the result function's defining equations.
definitions.text:
rule circularShiftResult(X:Int, SHIFT:Int)
    => str(buildIS(
         seqConcat(
           strToCodes(Int2String(X)),
           strToCodes(Int2String(X))),
         slAdjust(
           isLen(strToCodes(Int2String(X))) -Int SHIFT,
           isLen(seqConcat(
             strToCodes(Int2String(X)),
             strToCodes(Int2String(X)))),
           1),
         slAdjust(
           (2 *Int isLen(strToCodes(Int2String(X)))) -Int SHIFT,
           isLen(seqConcat(
             strToCodes(Int2String(X)),
             strToCodes(Int2String(X)))),
           1),
         1))
    requires notBool (
               SHIFT >Int isLen(strToCodes(Int2String(X))))
      andBool notBool (SHIFT <Int 0)

source_rules.rationale: This simplification rule adds the trusted definedness fact needed for the partial ASCII strToCodes function when its input comes from the fixed Int2String hook. Stage 1 compiles the rule into VERIFICATION before every kprove invocation and provides no prior proof of its exact statement in a module that omits it.
